name: What kind of warranty should I expect for moisture-damaged siding repair services?

mainEntity.name: What kind of warranty should I expect for moisture-damaged siding repair services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Reputable contractors typically offer a warranty on their workmanship for moisture-damaged siding repairs. This warranty usually covers the labor and installation for a specific period, often ranging from one to five years, ensuring that the repair holds up as expected. The materials used, such as siding panels or sealants, may also come with separate manufacturer warranties. Always clarify the specifics of both workmanship and material warranties with your contractor before starting the project to understand what is covered and for how long.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expect a workmanship warranty from contractors, typically 1-5 years, covering labor and installation. Materials may have separate manufacturer warranties.
